capabilities: Reuse code block content from a templates folder in any note
Substitute variables into templates via key=value pairs
Pass comma-separated anonymous variables without naming each one
Loop over array values to repeat a template line
Autocomplete template insertion by typing ... or ```pack-view
extras: Not yet published to the Obsidian community plugin store; the README describes manual installation from a GitHub release. A planned-development section lists reading local JSON and CSV data as a future feature.
problem: Obsidian's core Templates insert fixed note skeletons and cannot reuse code block content with per-use variable substitution.

summary: Template plugin that reuses content defined in code blocks across notes, with variables, anonymous variables, and array loop variables.
